tasks.title: SPIKE: join voice, speaking events per user, play audio back
tasks.note: Done in Python on py-cord pinned to PR #3159 — the only Python branch that decrypts DAVE on receive. Everything Discord lives in voice.py; @discordjs/voice is the fallback behind the same interface.

tasks.title: WebSocket server, emits the contract frames
tasks.note: ws://localhost:8787. Contract frames plus additive at/atMs, turn.start/tick/end, session.started/ended. Same frames on Redis (gavel:ears:events) and in Postgres.

tasks.title: speak handler — accept base64 audio, play it, emit spoken
tasks.note: speak/stop over the WebSocket or Redis gavel:ears:commands, played through FFmpeg. spoken carries interrupted/error.

tasks.title: Record a real session to replay.jsonl
tasks.note: `just export-replay` turns the last recorded call into replay.jsonl. Needs a real multi-person call recorded, then commit the fixture.

tasks.title: Tier 2 — per-speaker Opus decode, two simultaneous speakers
tasks.note: Per-user PCM from the py-cord sink. Frames still DAVE-encrypted while the session negotiates are dropped, not decoded into noise.

tasks.title: Tier 2 — SLNG STT, transcript frames
tasks.note: Streaming: one SLNG WebSocket per Discord user, diarization on (`speaker`), finals ~0.6–0.8s after a pause. deepgram/nova:3 default, soniox rt-v5 alt. STT_MODE=http keeps the per-utterance path.

tasks.title: Operator console + recording — /console, Postgres, Redis
tasks.note: http://localhost:8787/console: meeting + agenda setup, start/end session, live transcript, floor/turn debug, signal log, say-box through SLNG TTS. Every frame recorded to Postgres.

tasks.title: Load and validate the agenda, session state object
tasks.note: Agenda from session.started (ears console) or AGENDA_FILE; zod-validated; policy = YAML defaults ← agenda.

tasks.title: Talk-time state machine — rolling-window share per person
tasks.note: TalkLedger: total / per-topic / rolling-window per person from speaking frames. GET /state.

tasks.title: Replay harness — run replay.jsonl through the machine
tasks.note: pnpm replay <jsonl> — fake clock, --stub-llm, --policy k=v, --config dir. Fixture replay.offagenda.jsonl.

tasks.title: Agenda clock — current topic, spent vs budget, topics at risk
tasks.note: Topic clock, overrun → announce + advance, wrap-up after the last topic.

tasks.title: Interrupt policy — the triggers. This is the product
tasks.note: escalate / offAgenda (park + priority redirect) / floorHog / topicOverrun / silence (named invite, round robin). Pure, tested.

tasks.title: Mastra orchestration, thin — Nebius as the model, SLNG + fal as tools
tasks.note: Mastra agents chair/relevance/operator, ears+memory tools, intervene workflow; traces in Postgres schema mastra.

tasks.title: Nebius — one sentence in the chair's voice, template fallback
tasks.note: Qwen3-235B line (fast profile Qwen3-30B classifier), 2.5 s timeout → YAML template. Pre-composed during grace.

tasks.title: SLNG TTS, send speak frame over the wire
tasks.note: SLNG TTS (fish, ~1.2 s), cached per line → speak frame with priority.

tasks.title: Web stage — agenda, live talk-time bars, what the chair said
tasks.note: The visible half of the judged moment.

tasks.title: Fire drill — hazard heard, chair breaks in, host confirms, SMS goes out
tasks.note: The scripted laugh. Demo number only, never an emergency service; host must confirm out loud. Stage-button fallback if STT is not done.

tasks.title: fal face — Director livestream, steered on state change (lip-sync is the fallback)
tasks.note: Director = infinite livestream, steerable, no latency at the interrupt, fits the H3 Max track. First question to the mentor: is the output playable in a browser <video>? If yes the stage and Vonage both get it via canvas. Decide within 30m of the key working; still portrait if neither lands.

tasks.title: Tier 2 — transcripts, topic coverage, content-aware lines
tasks.note: Transcripts drive off-agenda detection + parking lot; minutes not yet.

tasks.title: Join session, subscribe to all, audio levels to speaking frames
tasks.note: Threshold ~0.2 with hysteresis. The hysteresis lives here, never in the brain.

tasks.title: Publish the chair's voice — AudioContext as the audio source
tasks.note: Never init a publisher with audioSource:false — it can never gain audio after.

tasks.title: Publish the chair's face — canvas captureStream, fal frames
tasks.note: Same canvas that renders the Director stream, captureStream()'d into the Vonage publisher. The one place the chair has a face in-call.

tasks.title: Vonage Messages — send one SMS, used by the fire drill
tasks.note: Destination is EMERGENCY_DEMO_NUMBER and nothing else.
